sections.heading: Phase 1: Build foundational skills (months 1-4)
sections.body: Strengthen the technical breadth needed for an Engineering Manager role.

bullets.text: Skill: budgeting and headcount planning basics
Evidence: lead a cross-team project end to end at Acme Corp
Learn from: shadow your own manager during planning cycles
LinkedIn action: use the Career Roadmap tool's own output to track progress monthly

sections.heading: Phase 2: Build visibility (months 5-8)
sections.body: Make your leadership work visible outside your immediate team.

bullets.text: Skill: written communication for broader audiences
Evidence: publish a retrospective on the on-call redesign
Learn from: engineering managers in your existing network
LinkedIn action: use Thought Leadership Comment to engage on engineering-management posts

bullets.flag_reason: Needs a real number from you -- team size or retention change -- to avoid guessing.
